decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the scale, design and location of the hoardings is appropriate to the area and does not harm the appearance of the area or traffic safety in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and Policy S.4.3 (Advertisements).
Condition : 2 - That this consent is granted for a temporary period of six months from the date of this decision or until completion of the development whichever is the later.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Informative: The applicants are advised that if the advertisements shown on the drawing are displayed earlier than one month before the start of works on site these will require advertisement consent from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a 2.4m site hoarding around building site
